title: "R for Data Science"

## Introduction

Welcome to our **introductory session on R software and its powerful ecosystem**. Learn how R can be used to produce compelling data products, such as reports with rich tables and visualizations.

We'll take a hands-on approach and even explore how to **recreate parts of the AITI ICT Survey Report 2022** using R and Quarto.

## 🧑‍🏫 Format

-   **Lecture-style** sessions with *live coding*.
-   Code will be provided for participants to follow along.
-   Two teaching assistants will be available for one-on-one help.

💻 *Participants must bring a laptop with R and RStudio installed.*

🚫 *No prior knowledge of R is required.*

## 🖥️ More of R & Statistics

Explore these resources to continue your journey with R:

### 📚 Learning Opportunities

- [UBD ILIA – Data Analysis for Leaders and Managers](https://ilia.ubd.edu.bn/programmes/data-analysis-for-leaders-and-managers/)  \
  A short course designed to help professionals apply data analysis techniques for decision-making in leadership roles.

- [UBD C3L – Digital Economy Courses](https://c3l.ubd.edu.bn/courses-and-programmes/14-week-courses-and-bachelor-of-science-in-digital-economy-bsc/)  \
  Includes 14-week micro-credential courses and degree programmes focused on data, digital tools, and economic insights.

- [Brunei R User Group](https://bruneir.github.io/) \
A local community of R users and data enthusiasts in Brunei.
Brunei R User Group conduct workshops and talks to share knowledge and explore data together.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 🌐 Online Resources

-   [R for Data Science (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)\
    A modern, beginner-friendly book to help you learn R for data wrangling, visualization, and analysis using the tidyverse.

-   [Quarto.org](https://quarto.org)\
    The official site for Quarto, used to create reproducible documents, websites, blogs, dashboards, and more using R.

-   [R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com/)\
    A rich collection of ready-to-use R visualizations with code examples, great for learning and inspiration.

and many more...
